{{Top|leg}}
'''City platforms''' were huge [[Repulsorlift/Legends|repulsorlift]] facilities that hovered above the surface of [[Lish V]]. Designed and constructed by [[Lant Mining Corporation]], they were miniature [[City/Legends|cities]] that housed living quarters, offices, and landing pads to support LMC's [[Mining/Legends|mining]] operations across the [[Moon/Legends|moon]]. Four city platforms were established on Lish V, including [[Gadde]].
